description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to claim expense types in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for name, status, and id, along with their getters and setters, and initializes the default sort field.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters (name, status, id) for claim expense types, extending the core FilterParams class and setting default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field as 'expenseType.name'.
